summary: First full run covering backend + frontend for the Prevent & Restore CMS (Express/Prisma via FastAPI shim, Next.js admin). Backend: 33/33 pytest pass, covering auth, lockout, origin guard, dashboard counts, blog lifecycle, slug-change 301 with flattening, redirects loop/chain/dup validation, reserved and redirect-colliding page slugs, taxonomy CRUD and in-use 409, services reorder plus the public list order, public lists/sitemap/404, and media PNG/JPEG upload plus 415 rejections. Frontend on the CLIENT_URL host (c6816511...): every requested flow passed: login/error, sidebar items, dashboard, logout redirect, blog list search/filter, blog create with blocks, move up/down, save -> /admin/blogs/:id, publish, preview, trash/restore, service edit (FAQ + related conditions), drag reorder 'Order saved' persisted, categories/tags CRUD and in-use error toast, redirect modal with loop error, settings save and storage status, authors manager, pages 'about-us' error toast, mobile menu. One environment-level HIGH issue: on the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host (https://prevent-restore.preview.emergentagent.com) the admin cannot log in. The page shows 'Cannot reach the server' because the client calls the absolute c6816511 API URL cross-origin and that origin is not in CLIENT_URL (CORS fails, and originGuard returns 403 for that Origin).

critical.issue: originGuard returns 403 'Origin not allowed' and CORS rejects the request because CLIENT_URL only lists https://c6816511-...preview.emergentagent.com and localhost. Users on the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL domain cannot log in.

minor.issue: CTA buttonUrl and image block url accept 'javascript:alert(1)' and can be published. Stored-XSS risk when the public site or the preview renders /. The paragraph html is sanitized but these URL fields are not. (Verified: blog published with javascript: CTA, then trashed.)
No check that fromPath is the URL of a live published item. An admin can create a redirect that shadows live content (publishing removes such redirects, but creating one afterwards is allowed).
Cache-Control public max-age=60 means a CDN may serve a stale order or content for up to 60s after reorder or publish. Acceptable, but worth documenting.

ui_bugs.issue: Login fails with 'Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.' because NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is hardcoded to the c6816511 host, which makes the call cross-origin from this domain.

issues: 404 for /fonts/FuturaPT-Book.woff2, /fonts/FuturaPT-Demi.woff2 and /fonts/BlairITCStd-Medium.woff2, so the brand fonts fall back to other fonts
Publishing sidebar card is empty (title only) for pages, which looks unfinished
Active toggle knob is rendered partly outside the track
Seeded blogs (2) and services (7) have no featuredImageUrl. Only 5 conditions have images, although the user asked for seed images copied from the site.

action_items: HIGH: Make the admin work on the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL domain. Use a same-origin relative API base ('/api') in the browser, or add https://prevent-restore.preview.emergentagent.com to CLIENT_URL (server/.env) and make NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL match the domain being served.
Validate CTA buttonUrl, image url and the faq/cta urls in blocks against allowed schemes (http/https/relative/mailto/tel) to block javascript: and data: URLs.
Add the missing font files under client/public/fonts or remove the @font-face references.
Optional: give the seeded blogs and services featured images; reject manual redirects whose fromPath is a live published item.
critical_code_review_comments: client/.env* hardcodes the preview host in NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, and server CLIENT_URL is a single host. This breaks on any other domain (including production domain changes), so prefer same-origin '/api'.
sanitizeBlocks only cleans text/html. Add URL scheme validation for cta.buttonUrl and image.url in the zod schema (validators/schemas.js).
The login limiter is 30 req/15min per req.ip. TRUST_PROXY=2 must match the real proxy hop count, or every user shares one IP bucket. Verify this in production.
Good: bcrypt $2b$ hashes, httpOnly session cookie, sessionVersion invalidation, timing-safe dummy hash, slug flattening in applySlugChange, P2025 mapped to 404.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all flows pass on the c6816511 host; login broken on the prevent-restore host)

seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_ blogs (ids 3-7) are left soft-deleted in trash. TEST redirects, tags, categories, authors and media were deleted. Service order restored to 1..7, service 7 FAQ/related reset to empty, and the settings default meta description restored to empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_cms_api.py. Run the UI tests on https://c6816511-f19e-4c63-836f-4d78e6c2e85c.preview.emergentagent.com (the configured CLIENT_URL). After the main agent's fix, also verify login on https://prevent-restore.preview.emergentagent.com. Restore and delete actions open a confirm dialog (confirm-ok-button). Saving a new item navigates client-side to /admin/<type>/:id (use wait_for_timeout rather than wait_for_url with the load event). Each TestAuth lockout run uses a random fake email.
rca of the issue: Login fails on prevent-restore: the Next client is built with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://c6816511-.../api, so the browser on prevent-restore makes a cross-origin request. Express cors() allows only env.clientOrigins (c6816511 and localhost), so the preflight/response lacks ACAO, fetch throws, and the user sees 'Cannot reach the server'. Even with CORS fixed, originGuard would return 403. Reproduce: curl -X POST https://prevent-restore.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login -H 'Origin: https://prevent-restore.preview.emergentagent.com' returns 403 {Origin not allowed}. Fix: same-origin relative API base, or add the origin to CLIENT_URL.
